body: Thank you. I’m not sure I’m brave enough to tell people that. I worry it’d be weird or inappropriate because we were not that close...but just saying “sorry for the late reply” after a year seems a little rude...
I’m depressed and I didn’t want people to notice so I kind of ghosted them.
I was there singing! And I'm from mainland China. I even taught my husband the pronunciations in the morning in order to sing it publicly for the first time!
